requested_scope_summary: One fresh, fixed H6 pack; one 700-update temporal development run on a separately fixed 3000-update cosine horizon; one matched predecessor retention panel; and eight ordered immutable-snapshot retention panels. No checkpoint selection and no counterfactual operation.

source_identity.required_source_bindings: exactly the sixteen bindings in governing_run_manifest.source_bindings
source_identity.issue_blocker: Authority cannot be issued until the exact currently untracked development sources and this contract package are committed and independently reviewed.

requested_attempt_semantics.reservation_mechanism: exclusive creation of the fresh S0 pack root before either H6 index is loaded

requested_allowed_operations: Before reservation, validate only exact source, interpreter, device, and fresh-root bindings without opening a runtime input.
Create the one immutable H6 uint8 pack as phase S0_pack.
After S0 exclusively creates the pack root and reserves the attempt, let each phase validate only its own exact runtime inputs in the order fixed by the governing manifest.
Execute the one fixed 700-update, schedule-horizon-3000 training job as phase S1_train.
Read only same-attempt snapshots derived and hash-bound by S1 final_trace for the fixed retention panel.
Execute the matched predecessor baseline as S2_retention_baseline and all eight ordered panels as S3_retention_snapshots.
Hash and report authorized inputs and same-attempt outputs through the machine receipts current source actually emits.

derived_same_attempt_snapshots.binding_rule: path, update, byte count, and SHA-256 must agree with the COMPLETE same-attempt S1 final_trace and an independent re-hash

receipt_and_supervision_boundary.required_before_issue: The authority must identify an external process supervisor for the hard wall/GPU ceilings and the reviewer responsible for the terminal decision record.

terminal_interpretation_boundary: The output is a non-citable development trajectory, not a scientific attempt.
No automatic checkpoint selection or success verdict is authorized.
The retention panel does not attribute encoder-versus-head drift; component-swap source is still absent.
A selected checkpoint, counterfactual input, counterfactual generation, counterfactual training, or task integration requires a new reviewed decision and authority.
explicitly_excluded_operations: Any counterfactual JSONL or RGB read, render, physics replay, generation, fidelity run, capacity training, planner-regret evaluation, or pilot execution.
Any legacy development pack, mutable latest checkpoint, or historical July 31 runtime output.
Any sealed, held-out, qualification, G2-G8, navigation, probability-calibration, promotion, production, deployment, retry, resume, overwrite, cleanup, output-root reuse, or network operation.
requirements_before_issue: Commit the exact source and contract bytes.
Bind one reviewed source commit containing every required source binding.
Produce an independent source-and-custody review that validates the schedule-horizon fix and focused synthetic tests.
Attest the attempt root is absent without opening any undeclared runtime payload.
Bind the authorizer and issue timestamp.
Reconfirm the exact GPU selector and the two hard time ceilings, bind their external process supervisor, and name the terminal reviewer.
